config.label: Region your Wraps stack is deployed in
config.description: Region your Wraps stack is deployed in. Optional only if your active AWS profile supplies one — SES identities are per-region.

config.label: AWS profile to use
config.description: AWS profile to use. Credentials are read locally and never leave the machine.

config.label: Set to true to enable the send_email tool
config.description: Set to true to enable the send_email tool. Read-only by default.

config.label: Default from address for send_email
config.description: Default from address for send_email. Must be a domain verified in your SES account.

config.label: Comma-separated addresses the agent may send to
config.description: Comma-separated addresses the agent may send to. Restricts send_email when write mode is on.

config.label: Comma-separated domains the agent may send to
config.description: Comma-separated domains the agent may send to. Matching is exact; list subdomains explicitly.

config.label: DynamoDB table holding email history
config.description: DynamoDB table holding email history. Defaults to wraps-email-history.
